description:
Build state-of-the-art machine learning models and infrastructure that deliver relevant, personalized ad experiences across non-Search surfaces on Amazon.com — incorporating deep product and shopper understanding to identify the most useful advertisements for hundreds of millions of customers. You'll drive major product and engineering initiatives with direct, measurable customer impact.

The Off-Search Monetization team within Sponsored Products builds customer experiences and ad products for advertisers. The team builds engineering infra changes and ML models to support these customer experiences and ad products. We conduct rapid A/B experimentation to ensure we surface the most relevant ads for shoppers. You'll work with Product Managers and Scientists to solve complex problems at Amazon scale — building ML infrastructure, designing distributed systems, and launching solutions in one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses. You will use AI to bring the experiences faster to market and improve operational excellence. 

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and optimize machine learning models incorporating deep product and shopper understanding to identify relevant advertisements across non-Search surfaces
- Architect and build ad serving systems that solve real-world customer use cases with high volume, low latency, and strict availability requirements
- Integrate ML solutions with large-scale distributed systems for click-through prediction and ad auction
- Measure impact and customer response through rapid A/B experimentation, iterating to improve relevance and performance
- Collaborate with Product Managers and Scientists to translate complex business problems into scalable engineering solutions

About the team
The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. 

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
